subtitle: A quiet corner for a short break.

purpose: Taking a short break while your computer agent works? Move the pointer into your chosen corner to set all connected displays to 0%. SceneHush leaves your session running; it does not prevent sleep or guarantee that agent tasks continue.
risk: Dimming is not locking. Anyone nearby may restore the screen and use your Mac. Lock your Mac when it is unattended or in a shared space.
system.conflict: This corner already has a macOS action
system.explanation: Replace its macOS Hot Corner action with SceneHush? The original setting will be saved so you can restore it in Settings.
system.restoreExplanation: Restore the macOS corner actions saved by SceneHush? SceneHush will be disabled to avoid conflicting actions.

error.dim: Could not dim displays. Open BetterDisplay and enable its command line integration, then try again.
error.restore: Some displays could not be restored. Reconnect them and choose Restore brightness now.
